mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status, icon_url, path, path_name, seo_keywords, seo_description, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM category WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status, icon_url, path, path_name, seo_keywords, seo_description, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM category WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY level, sort_order, id

SELECT id, name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status, icon_url, path, path_name, seo_keywords, seo_description, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM category WHERE level = #{level} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT id, name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status, icon_url, path, path_name, seo_keywords, seo_description, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM category WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.parent_id, c.level, c.sort_order, c.status, c.icon_url, c.path, c.path_name, c.seo_keywords, c.seo_description, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted FROM category c INNER JOIN category_closure cc ON c.id = cc.descendant_id WHERE cc.ancestor_id = #{ancestorId} AND cc.depth >= 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY cc.depth, c.sort_order, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.parent_id, c.level, c.sort_order, c.status, c.icon_url, c.path, c.path_name, c.seo_keywords, c.seo_description, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted FROM category c INNER JOIN category_closure cc ON c.id = cc.ancestor_id WHERE cc.descendant_id = #{descendantId} AND cc.depth >= 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY cc.depth ASC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.parent_id, p.level, p.sort_order, p.status, p.icon_url, p.path, p.path_name, p.seo_keywords, p.seo_description, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted, c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, c.description AS c_description, c.parent_id AS c_parent_id, c.level AS c_level, c.sort_order AS c_sort_order, c.status AS c_status, c.icon_url AS c_icon_url, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM category p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.parent_id = p.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.level = #{level} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id, c.sort_order, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, description, parent_id, level, sort_order, status, icon_url, path, path_name, seo_keywords, seo_description, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{parentId}, #{level}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{iconUrl}, #{path}, #{pathName}, #{seoKeywords}, #{seoDescription}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, parent_id = #{parentId}, level = #{level}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, icon_url = #{iconUrl}, path = #{path}, path_name = #{pathName}, seo_keywords = #{seoKeywords}, seo_description = #{seoDescription}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE category SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE category c INNER JOIN category_closure cc ON c.id = cc.descendant_id SET c.deleted = 1, c.updated_at = NOW() WHERE cc.ancestor_id = #{ancestorId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category_closure (ancestor_id, descendant_id, depth) VALUES (#{ancestorId}, #{descendantId}, #{depth})
